Oggy — Generative and agentic AI and false claims in settlement claims processing (research memo, Nov. 2026)

A narrative summary of Oggy's research memo on whether generative or agentic AI has been used to submit false claims to class-action, MDL and mass-tort settlement claims processes. Fabricated evidence and bot-driven volume fraud are well documented on the dockets, but no filing found says generative AI made a fake document; the agentic threat is so far a forecast. Covers the doctrine under Rule 23(e), the new administrator-AI disclosure orders, and what courts do when fraud turns up, followed by a self-critical Oggy Assessment.
